text:
Lina: Quick sync — we need to rebalance Q4 slate. The current RICEs in the doc feel skewed toward reach; customers keep asking for reliability fixes that score low on reach but high on impact/confidence. Thoughts?
Marcus: Agreed. Example: Dedicated autoscaling cost controls — low reach but cuts costs 30% for three large customers. RICE reach=2, impact=8, confidence=7 -> total=56. Feels underprioritized.
Jay: We also have the opposite: small UX polish with reach=9, impact=3, confidence=9 -> total=54. So totals are close but different business outcomes.
Priya: Can we add a modifier for strategic customers / revenue risk? Currently RICE treats reach uniformly.
Lina: Proposal A: keep RICE but add a weighted multiplier for revenue impact (x1.0-1.5) when a customer contract or regression risk exists. Proposal B: shift from reach 20% -> 15% and impact 45% -> 50% (i.e., more weight on impact).
Marcus: Quick math: with Proposal B, autoscaling moves to top-3. Also reduces churn risk.
Jay: Concern: changing weights mid-quarter causes churn in trust of scores. We need a clear retro and comms if we shift.
Priya: Another idea: keep scores but add a quantitative "Risk to Revenue" tag that forces exec review for anything > $X/mo impact. That avoids re-scoring everything.
Lina: Good call. Can someone sketch the threshold? Eng-prod-bot: Document added: https://redwood.internal/prioritization/q4-rebalance (new section: revenue-risk-tags). :white_check_mark:
Marcus: For launch criteria, can we require "customer signoff" for customer-driven items and "benchmarked latency improvement" for infra items? Keeps acceptance consistent.
Jay: Agree on acceptance gates. Also suggest a tie-break rule: if RICE within 5 pts, prefer lower-latency/regression-risk items.
Priya: I'll draft the revenue threshold table: small (<$5k/mo) no tag, medium ($5k-50k) product manager review, large (>$50k) exec review.
Lina: Timeline: Priya to draft thresholds today, Marcus to enumerate top 6 candidate items with current RICE and proposed reweighting by EOD, Jay to write comms note explaining the process. We'll convene a 20-min sync tomorrow.
Jay: One more: let's record confidence rationale for each score (1-2 sentence) so future retros can be concrete.
Marcus: :thumbsup: agree. Also calling out dependencies (platform infra, dedicated infra) in the doc helps sequencing.
eng-prod-bot: Reminder: next product all-hands will include a 5-min slot for Q4 prioritization update on 2026-03-23.
Lina: Thanks all — I'll update the doc with the decisions and link back after Marcus and Priya post their pieces. :slightly_smiling_face:
